title: Determine Distance on the Coordinate Plane

items.stem: What is the distance between the points (3, 4) and (7, 4) on the coordinate plane?
A student plots two points on the coordinate plane: A(2, 5) and B(2, -3). What is the vertical distance between points A and B?
Select ALL the correct statements about finding distances on the coordinate plane:
choices: The horizontal distance is the difference between the x-coordinates of two points.
The vertical distance is the difference between the y-coordinates of two points.
To find the distance between two points on the same line, you add their coordinates.
The distance between two points can be found by counting the units between their coordinates on each axis.

items.stem: Two points, C(-4, 1) and D(3, 1), lie on the same horizontal line. Explain how to find the distance between points C and D. Show or explain your work.
